svg.title: CPU strong-scaling speedup by decomposition
svg.desc: Solver speedup relative to the serial build against CPU workers for the OpenMP thread sweep, the MPI rank sweep, and labelled MPI-by-OpenMP hybrid placements, with the ideal line, one panel per machine. Computational diagnostic; no confidence intervals.
